name: Jean & Alexander Heard Library

decisions: Metro has 10 footprints here where OSM has one; compared against their union, OSM kept as one building (roof parts split it)
OSM and Metro differ (corner p95 4.41 m); OSM is as close or closer to the LiDAR edge (0.99 vs 0.95 m): OSM used
LiDAR roof edge lies a uniform 0.18 m outside the walls: logged as roof overhang, not corrected
2 edge(s) more than 0.3 m off the LiDAR edge moved to it: 9.75 m edge inward 1.02 m; 4.99 m edge outward 1.43 m

material_rule: walls and vertical roof steps brick_red (guess); roof faces flatter than 6 deg roof_flat, steeper roof_slate unless the Metro 2026 ortho color is clearly green (roof_copper) or orange-red (roof_tile); base concrete
